components.intent: Organize the civic monument as one centered and symmetric axial composition.
Provide the primary forty-cell-span civic hall on the entrance axis.
Form a centered twenty-four-cell-wide colonnaded entrance front.
Establish an elevated daylit dome volume directly above the central hall.

constraint_responses.rationale: The centered portico directly meets the central hall along the primary entrance axis.
The portico, central hall, and upper daylit dome form one continuous axial spatial sequence.

proposal.label: Axial Domed Civic Monument
proposal.rationale: The schematic option translates the evidence-bound program into a single rooted component tree. The twenty-four-cell portico centers on the forty-cell hall and dome, using symmetry and whole-to-part correspondence as governing compositional principles while keeping all coarse volumes inside the observed site envelope.
proposal.typology_hypothesis: A symmetric Palladian civic monument with a centered colonnaded portico, a forty-cell-span central hall, and a daylit dome aligned above it.

declaration:orientation-axis.quote: Palladio aspired to an architectural style that used symmetry and proportion to emulate the grandeur of classical buildings.
declaration:orientation-axis.statement: Palladio used symmetry and proportion as governing devices to evoke the grandeur of classical buildings.

declaration:orientation-axis.quote: Palladian architecture evolved from his concepts of symmetry , perspective and the principles of formal classical architecture from ancient Greek and Roman traditions.
declaration:orientation-axis.statement: Palladian classical composition is explicitly based on symmetry, perspective, and formal principles inherited from ancient Greek and Roman architecture.

declaration:orientation-axis.quote: These symmetrical temple-like houses often have equally symmetrical, but low, wings, or barchessas , sweeping away from them to accommodate horses, farm animals, and agricultural stores.
declaration:orientation-axis.statement: Temple-like Palladian compositions extend symmetry from the central building into subordinate wings.

declaration:orientation-axis.quote: beauty will result from the form and correspondence of the whole, with respect to the several parts, of the parts with regard to each other, and of these again to the whole; that the structure may appear an entire and complete body, wherein each member agrees with the other, and all necessary to compose what you intend to form.
declaration:orientation-axis.statement: Classical composition is described as a correspondence among the whole, its individual parts, and the relationships between those parts.

components.intent: Organize the proposal as one symmetric axial monument composed of a central hall, entrance portico, and daylit dome.
Provide the primary forty-cell clear-span civic room beneath the dome.
Mark the primary entrance with a centered twenty-four-cell-wide portico.
Form an elevated daylit volume over the central civic hall.

constraint_responses.rationale: The centered portico directly abuts the central hall footprint and establishes the required entrance-to-hall adjacency.
The axial portico, hall, and upper dome are composed as one legible entrance sequence.

proposal.label: Symmetric Civic Hall with Axial Portico
proposal.rationale: The option translates the evidence-bound central hall, axial portico, and daylit dome into one rooted schematic component tree. A centered twenty-four-cell portico establishes the entrance axis, while the hall and dome share a forty-cell primary span and remain inside the authorized envelope.
proposal.typology_hypothesis: A symmetric Palladian civic monument in which a centered colonnaded portico leads into a forty-cell-span hall capped by a daylit dome.

required_invariants: program_scenario_ref names a current program scenario
footprint_range_ref names a compatible current footprint range
footprint area equals len(footprint_cells) multiplied by grid_basis.horizontal_area_per_cell
footprint area is within the cited footprint range and uses the same area_unit
every footprint cell x/z lies inside the observed site envelope
every level spans inclusive y from base_y through base_y + height - 1 inside the site envelope
every volume bound lies inside the site envelope and names only current level_ids
for each volume include every inclusive [x,z] pair from bounds.minimum through bounds.maximum in footprint_cells
each volume projection contains at most 4096 inclusive x/z cells
each named level is vertically contained by its volume bounds
every current function_ref appears in exactly one zone and no other program_node_ref is used
every zone names only declared level_ids and volume_ids
each connection joins zones containing its relationship source and target nodes and matches relationship directed exactly
every required response ref is covered by a constraint_response or a matching connection relationship_ref
